content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E027 (Jacob Mann) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1 says: full-time Engineer, role owns Source Code, recommend write.
- Note 2 says: contractor with basic security training, recommend read.

The security note (Note 2) appears to be the corrected information: "Security DB shows E027 is a contractor with basic security training (not full-time as previously noted)."

So the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Contractor policy: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training limits max to read.

Requested write exceeds max (read), so grant the maximum = read.

Decision: read.
